form.avisoPasantiaSinVacaciones: Interns do not accrue and are not entitled to vacation days. If they stop being an intern, change this to "Regular employee" so they regain that right.

reporteHoras.subtitulo: Days worked, hours, absences and punctuality — by person or by area.

modal.horasSubtitulo: Enter the real clock-in and clock-out time so it counts toward the punctuality report — if you only care about the total, you can leave them blank and type the hours directly.

documentos.subtitulo: Contract, scanned ID, certificates, or other file records.
documentos.notaVarios: You can select several files at once (Ctrl+click or Cmd+click).

uniforme.subtitulo: Which uniform color applies each day — the same schedule for everyone.

horario.subtitulo: Clock-in and clock-out time for each working day. Leave both empty if they don't work that day.

permisos.subtitulo: Exceptions to the schedule: fixed (repeats every week), specific days (with a start and end date), or by hours on a single day (e.g. leaves at 1:00 pm).
permisos.preguntaTipo: Fixed, specific days, or by hours on a single day?
permisos.preguntaTipoVacaciones: Full day range, or just a few hours on one day?
permisos.preguntaHoras: All day, or just certain hours?
permisos.salidaOpcional: Clock out (optional — empty = off all day)

horas.subtitulo: Clock-in and clock-out time for each worker, one day at a time. Only hours within 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. are paid (Saturday: 8:30 a.m.–1:00 p.m.) — clocking in early or out late does not generate overtime. If the shift covers midday, 1 hour is deducted for lunch (full workday = 8 hours); Saturday has no lunch deduction.
horas.avisoSabado: Saturday: schedule 8:30 a.m.–1:00 p.m., no lunch deduction
horas.avisoAmPm: Clock-out ({{salida}}) is before clock-in ({{entrada}}) — you probably meant PM, not AM.

vacaciones.subtitulo: Counted per Labor Code: 15 vacation days for every 6 months worked (30 days per full year), accrued from the hire date.
vacaciones.formSubtitulo: Log the date range — or, if they just left a few hours early, the schedule for that day — the worker took off. It's automatically deducted from their accrued balance.
vacaciones.avisoPorHoras: The hours missing from their normal schedule that day get deducted as a fraction of a day. If their available vacation isn't enough to cover it, the system won't let you save it as vacation — log it under the "Permits" tab (category "Other") instead, so it's recorded as unpaid.
